title: §07-003: Timers, Delays & Asynchronous Scheduling
description: Multiple-choice practice questions and deep runtime verification for §07-003 (Timers, Delays & Asynchronous Scheduling).

cards.concept: Timers, Delays & Asynchronous Scheduling: libuv Event Loop Phase Ordering
cards.question: Which sequence correctly describes the phases of a single tick of the libuv event loop in Node.js?

options.text: Poll -> Timers -> Close -> Check -> Pending Callbacks
Timers -> Pending Callbacks -> Idle/Prepare -> Poll -> Check -> Close Callbacks
Threadpool -> Network IO -> Microtasks -> Timers -> Cleanup
Check -> Poll -> Timers -> Pending Callbacks -> Close Callbacks

cards.explanation: libuv loop iteration steps through: 1. Timers (setTimeout/setInterval), 2. Pending Callbacks (OS I/O), 3. Idle/Prepare (internals), 4. Poll (retrieve new I/O events), 5. Check (setImmediate), 6. Close Callbacks.
cards.pitfall: Assuming setImmediate and setTimeout(fn, 0) execute in deterministic order when invoked from top-level script scope (subject to process scheduling jitter).
cards.citation: libuv Official Architecture Documentation: Loop Iteration Phases

cards.concept: Timers, Delays & Asynchronous Scheduling: libuv Thread Pool Workloads
cards.question: Which of the following operations in Node.js utilize the internal libuv thread pool (UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE, default 4)?

options.text: TCP network sockets and HTTP server connections.
File system operations (fs), DNS lookups (dns.lookup), compression (zlib), and specific crypto functions (crypto.pbkdf2, scrypt).
setTimeout and setImmediate timers.
Parsing JSON payloads with JSON.parse().

cards.explanation: Network I/O is non-blocking via OS polling (epoll/kqueue). libuv offloads blocking file system I/O, synchronous DNS resolutions, zlib, and CPU-intensive crypto to its thread pool.
cards.pitfall: Running multiple heavy crypto.pbkdf2 tasks concurrently exhausts the 4-thread pool, blocking all file I/O and dns.lookup calls.
cards.citation: Node.js API Reference: Threadpool Usage & Libuv Architecture
